stalker-desc: Stalker AI: status of every loaded walker, its stage, its victim, and a self-test
stalker-status-desc: Shows each loaded walker's mode, stage, victim, gaze and ladder clocks, nearest first, or those within the given radius of you
stalker-stage-desc: Sets the ladder stage (1 to 5) of every loaded walker, or of those within the given radius of you; the stage's clocks start again
stalker-victim-desc: Makes a player (by name) or any entity (by id, a stand-in) the victim of every loaded walker the director did not place, or of those within the given radius
stalker-selftest-desc: Checks the ladder, the gaze and the slip-away with a playerbot stand-in at the world spawn; for the headless smoke test
stalker-status-gaze: watched {0} ({1}), frozen {2}, watched {3} s in all, looks {4}, slips away: {5}, broke off: {6}
stalker-status-ladder: stage clock {0} h, nights {1}, acts {2}, sightings {3}, hunt nights {4}, company {5} h, provoked {6}
stalker-stage-set: Set the stage of {0} walker(s) to {1}
stalker-victim-unknown: No living player or entity called or numbered {0}
stalker-victim-set: {0} walker(s) now haunt {1} #{2}; {3} placed by the director left as they are
